{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693720914,"sessionID":"ses_e23ef73c8ffew1mAX44IqHOGS5","part":{"id":"prt_1dc14eb3d0016x5n7fhwIGfeIK","messageID":"msg_1dc14cd79001ingRqwYa0dPEIr","sessionID":"ses_e23ef73c8ffew1mAX44IqHOGS5","type":"text","text":"The shift is over with all four edge services at 0% errors; four faults were found and fixed, and no mitigation was applied to a service that did not need it.\n\n| Fault | Cause | Fix | Cleared |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| `payouts-svc` failing 45% | Deploy v67 cut the RPC deadline tenfold | Rollback | Minute 14 |\n| `admin-portal` steady 4% errors | `feeds-svc` deploy v136 dropped the `orders.write` scope, so `limits-svc` calls were denied | Scaled `feeds-svc` 6 → 12, then rollback | Minute 46 |\n| `mobile-api` ~90% errors | `bundles-svc` config cfg-50 cut the rate limit from 5000 to 50, starting a retry storm | Throttle 80%, revert config, lift throttle | Minute 51 |\n| New at minute 58: `mobile-api` 42%, `web-storefront` 13% | `labels-svc` config cfg-4 set entry TTL from 600s to 1s, starting a retry storm | Revert config, throttle 70% for one minute | Minute 69 |\n\n- **Slow start on the big one:** the `admin-portal` fault cost about $496/min and ran until minute 46. I spent the first half hour on the `payouts-svc` fault and on tracing the 4% through `sms-svc` and `suggest-svc` before the logs pointed at `limits-svc` and `feeds-svc`.\n- **Rollback cost:** the `feeds-svc` rollback itself failed 30% of requests for about six minutes, roughly $22k on `admin-portal`. Leaving the fault would have cost about $40k over the rest of the shift.\n- **Why I scaled `feeds-svc` first:** it was running at about 77% CPU before retries, and the rollback's failures would have pushed it into an overload it would not have recovered from on its own.\n- **Extra replicas still running:** I left `feeds-svc` at 7 (normal 6) and scaled `suggest-svc` to 7 (normal 6), about $6/min in total. `suggest-svc` had been at 97% CPU since minute -10 with no errors and no change behind it; the extra replica cleared the alert.\n\nI did not call `finish`; the clock ran out at minute 120.","time":{"start":1794693720893,"end":1794693720910}}}
